column3: BootUI decides it from its authorization layer. sharpit observes no authorization decision (FastAPI security dependencies decide inside the endpoint) and a missing principal does not prove anonymity, so the check reports NOT_APPLICABLE with that reason, ahead of any missing-source check. SEC-AUTHZ-002 and SEC-AUTHZ-001 cover part of it statically.
